label: Cell internal short
definition: Confirmed or suspected internal electrical short within the battery cell

label: Lithium bridging or clustering
definition: Metallic lithium growth or clustering implicated in an internal battery short

label: Lithium plating with self-depletion
definition: Lithium plating identified within the cell and linked to elevated internal self-depletion

label: Latent anode-cathode leakage path
definition: Internal battery leakage path developing between anode and cathode with or without lithium re-plating

label: Separator or electrode-barrier failure
definition: Failure or inadequate separation permitting abnormal internal current path

label: Cell seal or electrolyte failure
definition: Cell-level seal degradation leakage or electrolyte-related failure

label: Battery header failure
definition: Failure involving the battery cell header rather than the CIED lead connector header

label: Battery feedthrough failure
definition: Electrical leakage mechanical damage corrosion or hermetic failure at battery feedthrough

label: Battery terminal pin corrosion
definition: Corrosion of a battery terminal pin disrupting connection to generator electronics

label: Battery-to-hybrid interconnect failure
definition: Abnormal connection between battery terminals/posts and electronic module or hybrid

label: Premature depletion unspecified
definition: Unexpected battery depletion without a demonstrated cell mechanism

label: Abnormal electronic current drain
definition: Excess current consumption attributable to device electronics or circuitry

label: Capacitor related drain
definition: Unexpected depletion associated with capacitor charging reforming or capacitor subsystem

label: Telemetry related drain
definition: Unexpected battery consumption associated with telemetry or communications activity

label: Firmware or software related drain
definition: Unexpected battery consumption caused or suspected to be caused by firmware/software behaviour

label: Generator feedthrough or hermetic failure
definition: Electrical or fluid leakage associated with the generator can feedthrough or hermetic interface

label: Can weld or package integrity failure
definition: Loss of generator package integrity involving enclosure weld or can

label: CIED header or seal ingress
definition: Fluid ingress or compromised sealing involving the generator lead-connector header

label: Lead terminal pin under-insertion
definition: Lead terminal pin incompletely seated in the intended connector bore

label: Lead terminal pin misconnection
definition: Lead terminal pin inserted or attached incorrectly in the generator header

label: Header bore insertion problem
definition: Difficulty seating a lead due to bore geometry obstruction contamination or dimensional issue

label: Intermittent header contact
definition: Intermittent electrical connection at terminal ring spring contact or connector block

label: Header spring-contact failure
definition: Failure deformation corrosion or dysfunction of spring contact elements within connector block

label: Setscrew interface failure
definition: Abnormal terminal fixation or electrical contact involving setscrew or setscrew block

label: Header contact interface failure
definition: Generic abnormal electrical contact at the generator header when a more specific mechanism is not supported

label: Electrical arc-over within header
definition: Electrical arc or flashover involving generator-header components

label: Inter-contact current leakage
definition: Current leakage between normally isolated connector poles or contact regions

label: Inter-contact short circuit
definition: Electrical short between connector poles or contact regions

label: Connector seal degradation
definition: Ageing damage or failure of lead-carried connector sealing elements

label: Connector terminal damage
definition: Mechanical damage cracking deformation or wear of lead terminal body or contact region

label: Inter-contact contamination or cross-contact
definition: Physical contamination fluid bridge or material failure creating abnormal interaction between contact regions

label: Crosstalk signal without proven physical leakage
definition: Reported crosstalk or cross-channel sensing without evidence of current leakage or a connector short

label: Conductor fracture
definition: Mechanical conductor fracture or discontinuity

label: Outer insulation breach
definition: Failure of external lead-body insulation

label: Inner or conductor insulation breach
definition: Failure of insulation separating conductors or internal electrical elements

label: Shock coil or high-voltage conductor failure
definition: Failure involving shock coil or high-voltage conductor path

label: Fixation or helix failure
definition: Failure damage or dysfunction of active fixation mechanism

label: Lead dislodgement
definition: Macro- or micro-dislodgement causing clinically relevant change

label: Engineering mechanism unresolved
definition: Available evidence does not support a specific engineering mechanism

label: Returned product no fault found
definition: Manufacturer analysis reports no confirmed product malfunction

label: Spring-contact/terminal-ring fretting with particle oxidation
definition: Repeated micro-motion at lead terminal ring/spring contact causing wear particles that may accumulate/oxidize and contribute to intermittent contact or impedance excursions

label: Spring-contact dimension out of specification
definition: Returned-product analysis confirms spring-contact geometry outside specification with potential for suboptimal terminal-ring contact

label: Spring-contact contamination or coating
definition: Foreign film debris or coating on a header spring contact that degrades electrical contact with the lead terminal
